title: This week in the family: 9 November to 15 November 2026
summary: 238 leads, 318 first emails and 973 WhatsApp pitches drafted, on free tiers only.

sections.heading: Leads
lines: We listed 238 new leads. 218 of them (92%) have no website of their own: we found them on a directory or map listing, and that page is the proof.

sections.heading: First messages
lines: We drafted 318 first emails and 973 WhatsApp pitches. None went out on their own: the team reads, fixes and sends each one by hand.

sections.heading: Who we would talk to
lines: We found the contact's role for 28 leads: Founder 11, Owner 10, Other 4, Principal / Partner 1, Practice / Office Manager 1. A role only; we never record a person's private details.

sections.heading: What the Validator refused
lines: Every write passes our Validator first; a refusal is a rule doing its job, and a wasted call. Per member:
The CEO: 59% of 2,698 actions refused (last week 48%).
Package Designer: 31% of 668 actions refused (last week 32%).
Scout: 15% of 287 actions refused (last week 29%).
Lead Gen: 26% of 4,237 actions refused (last week 32%).
Research Analyst: 21% of 3,482 actions refused (last week 19%).
Outreach Writer: 24% of 4,279 actions refused (last week 27%).
Lead Enricher: 36% of 2,819 actions refused (last week 31%).
Site Builder: 58% of 36 actions refused (not running last week).

sections.heading: Free tiers
lines: On the 7 days we measured (9 November to 15 November) we made 27,061 model calls, about 110.5 million tokens, across 9 free providers. Our bill: $0.

sections.heading: Providers
lines: Joined our chain: freeai.
Left our chain: ollama-cloud.

sections.heading: What broke and what we fixed
lines: Queue 550, Validator half . - lessons: a lesson keeps the rule and drops any pointer to a row (, , ), when written and when rendered, so the ledger's old…
World objects react to effects and to each other . - One rule system a script): objects carry materials (wood, leaves, electric, fire, water, a business, stone,…
Resting members become interactive ; everything data-true. - Wake with a click: a resting member's window shows why it rests (its list empty, things blocked…
The dev and deploy CSS break, and resting members bunched . - webapp/.gitignore: /.next-*/ and /test-results/. Tailwind 4 scans every file git does not…
Resting members practise . - A resting member steps off its spot, wanders a short way on the shore path or the grass a script wanderSpot: free floor,…
Queue 548's test typed for tsc: actEvent can return null and an FxEvent a city has no 'to' on every kind ('s test passed under Node but failed tsc). 290…
No Knight in the world . - The Validator's figure is gone from both worlds: its place by the notice board, its name, its hover and tap label, its field…
Queue 547, Validator half : three board jobs. - a script, nightly: commits and pushes the live data files under common-data by an explicit path list…

sections.heading: What broke and what we fixed
lines: Settings → Providers and the Allowance view show the Validator's last tick, and a red line when it is older than 30 minutes or missing
Db-standby.sh --to-local never shrinks the Mac's database unasked: fewer leads in the source than the target is refused (--yes-shrink to copy anyway)
Brochure: the world picture no longer shows a lead's name and city in the sky
Listing-evidence-backfill.py --repair: the 667 lines the first run wrote into evidence move to listing_evidence
World screens: as a badge on the box, and the Validator's flag back as an HTML line
The owner's Stop is never an empty file: in STOP and in the log, and on the mat
Restart-bot.sh says when launchd does not have the bot and refuses a bot the owner stopped on the dashboard; tick to-dos drop answered decisions
Speka: mistral-large-4 replaces gpt-oss-20b, pulled from its catalogue (every call failed since 10-30)
